name: codex_review
description: Run Codex native read-only code review (default: gpt-6.2-sol + medium effort + default tier; uncommitted changes, base branch diff, commit, or custom review instructions).

effort.description: Reasoning effort (default: medium for sol, xhigh for luna).

model.description: Optional model override (default: gpt-6.2-sol; e.g. gpt-6.2-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6.1-terra).

thread_id.description: Optional existing thread_id to review inside that context.
